projects.name: Local release evidence checklist
projects.purpose: Guide a human through collecting and reviewing release evidence before publishing a local capability package.
projects.inputs: A candidate package, its intended release revision, and available local check results.
projects.outputs: A dated evidence checklist with pass, fail, inconclusive, and not-run outcomes plus explicit human follow-up steps.
projects.constraints: Local and reviewable; do not run a scheduler or claim workflow-engine execution; preserve source references and separate authored expectations from observed checks.
projects.instructions:
1. Identify the candidate revision and package files.
2. Run the available structural generator and backup round-trip checks.
3. Record each check as pass or fail with command and evidence path.
4. Ask a human to review release readiness and publication authority.
5. Stop on missing or contradictory evidence.
projects.acceptance: The walkthrough shows one synthetic pass and one synthetic fail; each outcome names its evidence and human action. Structural checks are executed separately from this authored walkthrough.
projects.components: Checklist template, evidence ledger, backup fixture, generated workflow plan
projects.evidence: Structural generator and backup parser checks are run locally; the walkthrough below is synthetic authored documentation.
